title: 7 Salesroleplay.app Alternatives for AI Sales Roleplay (2026)
summary: Compare 7 salesroleplay.app alternatives for AI sales roleplay, with public prices checked November 2026, a two-week pilot, and what to verify before you buy.
body_markdown:
Tool


Best for


Public pricing (checked November 16, 2026)


What to test


[Quotain](https://www.quotain.com/product/ai-sales-simulations)


Practice tied to a real upcoming buyer


Starter $50 and Pro $100 per seat per month; 7-day free trial; Enterprise custom. Yearly billing is advertised at 20% off.


Buyer fidelity to your deal, score evidence, retry of one weak moment


[Hyperbound](https://www.hyperbound.ai/product/hyperbound-practice)


Free start, then custom multi-buyer and screen-share practice


Free plan with 45 prebuilt roleplays; Practice and Perform licenses quoted per user


Multi-party session, screen-share demo, full paid quote


[Kendo](https://kendo.ai/pricing)


A published per-seat price with roleplay and live-call scoring


Free trial; Pro $55 and Max $100 per seat per month; Enterprise custom


Minute limits against your weekly practice volume


[Yoodli](https://yoodli.ai/pricing)


Individual practice with published prices, or a quoted team plan


Individuals can start free; Pro $8 and Advanced $20 per month billed annually; Business and Enterprise quoted per seat


Team admin controls and whether sales scenarios match your motion


[Outdoo](https://www.outdoo.ai/pricing)


Voice, chat, video, and in-person practice with a free start


Free plan with 60 minutes and no credit card; paid plans by quote


Shared scoring between practice and live calls; plan limits


[PitchMonster](https://www.pitchmonster.io/pricing)


Phone, avatar, and screen-share practice in one per-seat quote


Two quote-based plans priced per seat; standard contracts listed as 12 months, with 3- and 6-month options


Consistency across practice modes; seat swap terms


[Second Nature](https://secondnature.ai/)


Avatar-led practice and LMS delivery


No prices on the pages reviewed; the site offers free role plays and routes paid plans to a demo


Avatar value, scenario setup time, LMS delivery (SCORM or LTI)
